name: devswarm-wake-watch
description: DevSwarm idle-wake: watches this workspace's own mailbox (read-only, poll-based) and emits a stdout line the instant new direct mesh mail lands, waking an idle session with lower latency than the cron fallback. Additive only — never disarms or replaces the unconditional CronCreate fallback (the engine owns the cron fallback).

name: agent-wake-watch
description: Session wake: stays silent until the agent tracker queues a wake row for this session (an agent idle with an open task, looping or burning tokens, or a watched background process that ended), then prints one line so an idle session is woken. Reads one small file of its own session; no tokens while quiet. Off with agents.wakeWatch.
